entries.en: The zoologist moved the Ampeliscidae drawings to a separate folder before revising the identification guide.
entries.zh: 动物学家在修订鉴定指南之前，把藤钩虾科的图画移到了单独的文件夹里。

entries.en: The ampelopsin test results could not be compared because two sample labels had been switched.
entries.zh: 蛇葡萄素的检测结果无法比较，因为两份样品的标签被调换了。

entries.en: An ampelopsis had spread across the old trellis, partly hiding the gate.
entries.zh: 一株蛇葡萄攀上了旧棚架，遮住了部分大门。

entries.en: The engineer recalculated the ampere-turns after discovering an error in the winding count.
entries.zh: 工程师发现线圈匝数有误后，重新计算了安匝数。

entries.en: The amperemeter's needle was stuck, so the technician marked the reading as unreliable.
entries.zh: 安培计的指针卡住了，因此技术员把该读数标记为不可靠。

entries.en: The amperozide study was excluded from the comparison because its original data were unavailable.
entries.zh: 那项安哌齐特研究没有纳入比较，因为其原始数据无法取得。

entries.en: The curator returned the Amphalius specimen to its drawer after checking the collection record.
entries.zh: 策展人核对藏品记录后，把双形蚤属标本放回了抽屉。

entries.en: The old case report described amphamphoterodiplopia but did not record when the symptoms began.
entries.zh: 那份旧病例报告描述了两眼复视，却没有记录症状何时开始。

entries.en: Several Ampharetidae specimens were missing from the tray described in the expedition notebook.
entries.zh: 探险笔记所记述的托盘里少了几件双栉虫科标本。

entries.en: The lecturer compared two historical illustrations of Ampharetinae without treating either as a modern identification guide.
entries.zh: 讲师比较了两幅双栉虫亚科的历史插图，并未把其中任何一幅当作现代鉴定指南。

entries.en: The amphecloral file contained a table whose sample numbers did not match the accompanying notes.
entries.zh: 那份胺苯氯醛档案中有一张表，其样本编号与随附笔记不一致。

entries.meaningZh: 脱氧麻黄碱〔旧商品名 Amphedroxyn〕
entries.en: The archive's Amphedroxyn advertisement was torn across the manufacturer's address.
entries.zh: 档案中的那则Amphedroxyn广告在厂家地址所在处破损了。

entries.meaningZh: 每日的；日发的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The old ward diary recorded amphemerous episodes of fever without identifying their cause.
entries.zh: 那本旧病房日志记载了每日发作的发热症状，却没有指出原因。

entries.en: The amphenidone report reached the reviewer with its last two pages missing.
entries.zh: 送到审稿人手上的安非尼酮报告缺少最后两页。

entries.meaningZh: 单体两性生殖的〔指孤雌生殖而产雌雄后代〕
entries.en: The researcher questioned the report's claim of ampherotokous reproduction because the offspring records were incomplete.
entries.zh: 后代记录不完整，因此研究人员质疑报告所称的雌雄同产型孤雌生殖。

entries.en: The revised table omitted the amphetaminil measurements that could not be traced to an original record.
entries.zh: 修订后的表格删去了那些无法追溯到原始记录的苯丙胺苄氰测量数据。

entries.en: The author questioned the evidence for amphi-permeability in the membrane shown in the diagram.
entries.zh: 作者对图示膜具有两透性的证据提出了质疑。

entries.en: The micrograph showed an amphiarkyochrome, although the surrounding tissue was out of focus.
entries.zh: 显微照片上可见一个双网染细胞，不过周围组织没有对焦清楚。

entries.en: The student revised her drawing of the amphiarthrodial joint after comparing it with the anatomical model.
entries.zh: 学生将图画与解剖模型比较后，修改了自己的微动关节图。

entries.en: During the lecture, she compared two drawings of the amphiblastic stage.
entries.zh: 讲课时，她比较了两幅两极囊胚阶段的图画。

entries.en: The student's drawing of an amphiblastula had no scale bar.
entries.zh: 学生画的两极囊胚图没有比例尺。

entries.en: The physician's account of amphiblestritis was incomplete because several examination notes had been lost.
entries.zh: 那位医生关于视网膜炎的记述并不完整，因为几份检查笔记已经遗失。

entries.en: The student shaded the amphiblestrodes in her diagram, leaving the adjacent structures uncoloured.
entries.zh: 学生给图中的视网膜涂上阴影，邻近结构则未着色。

entries.en: The missing labels made the amphiblestroid region difficult to locate in the old diagram.
entries.zh: 由于缺少标注，那张旧图中的视网膜区域很难定位。

entries.en: The committee returned the amphibolic statement to its author and asked for a clearer version.
entries.zh: 委员会把那段语意含混的陈述退还给作者，要求改写得更清楚。

entries.en: The museum's Amphibolidae specimens remained in their original boxes while the cabinets were replaced.
entries.zh: 更换柜子期间，博物馆的网纹螺科标本仍放在原来的盒子里。

entries.en: Her amphibolous reply left both teams unsure which deadline she intended.
entries.zh: 她模棱两可的答复让两个团队都不清楚她指的是哪个截止日期。

entries.en: The lecturer rotated a model of an amphicelous vertebra so everyone could see both ends.
entries.zh: 讲师转动一件两端凹的椎骨模型，让大家都能看清两端。
